chronicConditions.name: Essential hypertension
chronicConditions.notes: Home BP averages 135/82 on current dual therapy. No end-organ damage on most recent assessment. ECG with mild LVH.

chronicConditions.name: Mixed hyperlipidemia
chronicConditions.notes: LDL 98 mg/dL on rosuvastatin 20 mg. Total cholesterol 178. Tolerates statin well — no myalgias, normal LFTs.

surgeries.notes: Acute appendicitis at age 18. Uncomplicated recovery.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Karim Mostafa, Internal Medicine — Cleopatra Hospital, Cairo
clinicalNotes.content: Pre-Hajj review. BP well-controlled at 134/80 in clinic. Counseled patient to bring home BP cuff, check daily during Hajj. Encouraged to seek medic immediately for BP >170/100 or any new chest discomfort. ECG unchanged from baseline.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Heba Salah, Cardiology
clinicalNotes.content: Routine annual cardiology follow-up. No symptoms of ischemia, no palpitations. Echo from 2024-06 showed normal LV function, mild LVH consistent with long-standing HTN. Continue current regimen — no change indicated.

demoPresentingComplaint.ar: صداع خفيف يطلب فحص ضغط الدم بعد المشي الطويل في الحرارة.
demoPresentingComplaint.en: Mild headache, requesting blood pressure check after extended walking in the heat.
